design_philosophy: A serious security tool with a threat-ops console aesthetic. Data-dense, high-contrast, structural. Avoid soft gradients and standard SaaS styling. Optimize for role-based insights, F-pattern scanning, and rapid threat detection.

rules: Use JetBrains Mono for all critical data points, scores, and titles to reinforce the terminal aesthetic.
Line height: leading-none for headings, leading-relaxed for body.
Labels must be uppercase, tiny, and widely spaced.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 xl:grid-cols-8 gap-4 md:gap-6
rules: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children.
Bento box modularity for the dashboard panels.
Left-align text by default. Center-align only for isolated metrics or the main scanner input.
Dense padding inside data tables (p-2 or p-3), generous padding for main containers (p-6 or p-8).

general: DO NOT use standard HTML dropdowns/calendars. Use customized Shadcn UI components.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='url-scan-button').
Card components should be square-edged (rounded-none) to maintain the brutalist/terminal look.
Do not use soft shadows. Rely on 1px solid borders for separation.
url_scanner_hero: Include a blinking cursor effect or terminal prefix (e.g., '>_').
Button: Solid high-contrast (e.g., text-black bg-white hover:bg-gray-200) with monospace text.
verdict_card: Traffic-light color coding is critical here (Green/Yellow/Red).
Use a radial gauge or progress bar for the final score.
Apply 'The Tracing Beam' (neon glow border) if the verdict is PHISHING.
breakdown_panel: Use 'Control Room' span logic. 3 equal columns for ML (0.5), CNN (0.3), DB (0.2).
feature_analysis_table: Expose the grid skeleton (visible borders between rows).
Use mono fonts for IP addresses, entropy values, and feature names.
threat_intel_feed: Live-updating ticker or narrow vertical list.
Minimalist vote buttons (Up/Down) with hover highlights.

rules: Hover states must shift background color slightly and brighten borders.
Use staggered fade-in + slide-up (translate-y-2) for dashboard widgets on load.
Include a 'scanning' state animation for the URL analysis (e.g., scrolling raw text, progress bar).
Use background images subtly with max 10-15% opacity to avoid competing with data.
Do NOT use generic placeholder images.

image_urls.description: Abstract circular glitch effect - use as an extremely faint (opacity-5) background texture behind the verdict gauge or hero section.
A blue light in the dark - use dynamically as a background image with overlay (bg-black/90) for the main Threat Intelligence feed container to give it a deep, glowing feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply JetBrains Mono to all headings, numbers, and inputs. Add it via Google Fonts.
Ensure all backgrounds are #050505 or #0C0D10, avoiding generic grays.
Use data-testid on inputs, scan buttons, feed vote buttons, and tab triggers.
Recharts: Ensure grids and axes are dark (#1E2028), using chart_palette for data series.
